validFixtures.expectation: The bounded C# host answers ping, passes every declared JSON assertion, records zero host errors, and releases its loopback lease.
The consumer resolves the shared RimWorld editor manifest, templates, seed catalogs, and bounded retained mount map without missing relative paths.
A native-authority session mount has bounded retention, monotonic revision, refresh/readback semantics, and fail-closed late join behavior.
Actor identity, observation, native command authority, reconnect reconciliation, and typed rejection are declared without client gameplay mutation.

rejectionFixtures.expectation: An intent without a declared native JobGiver or WorkGiver mapping, or without a legal native target, is rejected without applying gameplay state.
Duplicate, stale, unavailable, illegal, and reconnect-stale requests return typed persisted outcomes and do not drift native state.

deletionGates: No C# behavior scorer or alternate intent-selection engine may be added to the RimWorld adapter.
No direct JSONL or file write may replace the declared Glue editor lifecycle.
No native affordance may be admitted without a real RimWorld JobGiver or WorkGiver legality check.
No package may be called publishable until the built host source commit and artifact hash are recorded and the original shared JSON template passes on that artifact.
